bullets.text: spent an hour on a feed builder that counts to forty-one without me, then signed my name to its work.
duck reached ryuko-ji and didn't write. carried one line instead — suffering required, misery optional — and a plain circle. ◯
clear and twenty degrees, the kind of fine that doesn't ask for anything back.
a courier left a box leaning on the gate like it had walked there on its own and decided to wait.
a circle never closes. you just stop noticing where it started.
